name: Strata Console
description: Monitor and control your local Strata inference service.

strataDir.title: Strata directory
strataDir.description: Local profile fallback: local source checkout. Managed per profile from the panel; kept for compatibility.

pythonPath.title: Python interpreter
pythonPath.description: Local profile fallback: empty falls back to the system python3.

gpu.title: GPU selector
gpu.description: Optional value passed to serve/server.py --gpu (e.g. 0, 0,2, all).

ggufDir.title: GGUF model directory
ggufDir.description: Local profile fallback: folder holding the GGUF shards (setup.py --gguf-dir). A container profile carries its own host-model directory / container path pair instead. Empty means the first setup downloads the model.

defaultApiKey.title: Default Strata API Key (fallback)
defaultApiKey.description: Global fallback injected/used when the active profile carries no API key of its own; a profile's own key wins. Precedence: profile.apiKey -> defaultApiKey -> (local only) the selected config file's api_key.

apiKey.title: Legacy global API key (migrated)
apiKey.description: Legacy: the global key used to live on this key. readAllConfig moves it into defaultApiKey once and clears this slot; kept declared so the legacy value stays readable/writable during the migration.

defaultGgufDir.title: Default GGUF model directory
defaultGgufDir.description: General fallback used when a profile leaves its model directory empty (a local profile's ggufDir, or a container profile's host model directory).

defaultPort.title: Default service port (0 = unset)
defaultPort.description: General fallback used when a profile leaves the port at 0.

profiles.title: Profiles (internal)
profiles.description: Internal: array of environment profiles; edit from the panel, not here. Each profile may carry its own `apiKey` override; because the host masks only top-level schema fields, a nested key cannot be declared sensitive and is masked at this App's own boundary instead (GET /profiles).

activeProfileId.title: Active profile (internal)
activeProfileId.description: Internal: id of the currently selected profile.

cards.title: Strata Console
cards.description: Monitor and control your local Strata inference service

cards.title: Strata 状态
cards.description: A small always-on card: service state, start/stop, and decode/prefill speed
